name: Ermine
description: The ermine spot: a black tail pinned above three dots, dropped at random across a plain field.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 0deg, 0deg, 180deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 30%; top: 32%; width: 40%; height: 56%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 82% 100%, 50% 74%, 18% 100%); clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 82% 100%, 50% 74%, 18% 100%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 36%; top: 8%; width: 28%; height: 20%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
